scope: Previously unaudited transfer paths; no new equilibrium species, empirical admission or omission-error guarantee.

Na_to_metal.existing_model: Na remains available to gas and silicate; associated_k has no Na metal component.
Na_to_metal.missing: A Na metal standard/activity law or a quantitative detection-limit-derived partition bound transferable to the declared state.
Na_to_metal.available: Five numerical S-free reported censoring limits with matching silicate Na; three FeS exchange constants replayed under two explicit concentration bases. Low-pressure standard/activities are not yet selected.

He_to_silicate.existing_model: He is an explicitly gas-only inert component. Chemical inertness does not imply zero physical solubility.
He_to_silicate.available: Measured low-pressure solubility, composition-dependent ionic-porosity law and high-temperature dry-host simulations.
He_to_silicate.missing: Declared BSE host/temperature/pressure continuation and a finite He budget response.

He_to_metal.missing: Low-pressure standard/partition continuation and its uncertainty for the actual alloy.

gessmann_wood_2002.locations: Tables 1, 2a and 4; discussion of Na analysis and below-detection metal products.
gessmann_wood_2002.reported_result: Na and K in these S-free metals are below detection; the retained paper gives no numerical Na detection limit for these runs.
gessmann_wood_2002.exclusion: The 2173.15 K, 24 GPa run 35 used a Na-free starting silicate and is not a Na observation. Sulfur-rich observations are not a bound for the sulfur-free source.

jambon_1986.access: Primary publisher abstract; full point table not retained.
jambon_1986.scope: Independent low-pressure scale comparison; not a measured 2173 K BSE value.

guillot_sator_2012.location: Appendix C, PDF page 35; values visually checked.
guillot_sator_2012.type: molecular dynamics model, not new experimental observations
guillot_sator_2012.S_units: cm3 STP / g dry melt / bar
cautions: Some low-temperature pure-host simulations are supercooled melts.
Host alternatives are not an empirical bracket for wet BSE.
MORB low-pressure agreement partly follows model calibration to existing noble-gas data.

iacono_marziano_2010.law: ln(x_g/f_g) = alpha_g*IP + beta_g; IP uses composition-dependent partial filled volumes and the Lange-Carmichael melt volume.
iacono_marziano_2010.scope: The pooled Ar/Ne/He fit error is not a 2173 K BSE extrapolation bound. He-bearing references include synthetic melts at about 108-198 MPa and 1473-1873 K; most other He data are near atmospheric pressure.
iacono_marziano_2010.next_reconstruction: Requires the original molar-volume convention and validation of fugacity units against retained measurements before finite-source use.

bouhifd_2013.locations: Supplementary Tables S2 and S3, PDF pages 6-7.
bouhifd_2013.D_basis: He mass fraction in metal divided by He mass fraction in silicate.
cautions: Table S3 silicate concentrations are interpolated from separate experiments, not simultaneous phase pairs.
Metal analytical errors can reach 100 percent for low concentrations.
Nominal room-temperature pressure can differ by several GPa from heated laser spots.
No 0.027 GPa Fe-Si-O-H or associated-alloy partition bound is inferred.

steenstra_2018.access: Primary Table1 and official Supplementary Tables S2-S4 retained and replayed; absolute common-standard reconstruction remains incomplete.
steenstra_2018.silicate_NaO_half_activity: Assumed ideal in the published fit.
steenstra_2018.Na_S_interaction: Assumed equal to the measured K-S effect by the authors.
steenstra_2018.implementation_status: Reference ratios, censoring bounds and balanced Henry-rebasing helper implemented; no selected absolute source standard or finite Na species.
steenstra_2018.limit_scope: Reported LA-ICP-MS censoring thresholds at 1 GPa and 1683-1883 K in graphite-saturated Fe-C/Fe-C-Si; noise/confidence definition not specified, not a 0.027 GPa BSE bound.
steenstra_2018.concentration_convention: The oxide-molecule reconstruction reproduces three FeS logK values within reported 2SE. A literal one-cation reconstruction differs by 0.264-0.308 dex; both are retained without fitting a correction.
